text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeze*...
Resolve really is important, isn't it,
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Having sprinted through the summer, Hishi Miracle was out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Once I make up my mind, it's like...
I just wanna give it everything I've got."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run and run and run,
something just wells right up from inside my heart!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Motivation? Energy? Responsibility?
Something along those lines, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I felt like I had to do so much more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The hot summer has come to an end, but Hishi Miracle's spirit is still burning bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seemed like a change for the better. Setting your mind to something
and giving it your all is always a good thing..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: How should I put it~... I feel like my heart has finally caught up to everyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them the real me this autumn.
Yes, the real...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle makes a confident declaration.
Her words are positive, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For just a moment...
they seemed to wear a wry smile.
